title: Ark of the Covenant
summary: The ark represented the Lord’s covenant presence, holiness, mercy seat, and the seriousness of approaching God rightly.
background: The ark belonged to the most holy place and was central to Israel’s worship symbolism. Its handling was surrounded by holiness and reverence.
teachingHelp: Teach ark passages with reverence, connecting presence, covenant, holiness, and mercy as the text allows.
